subject.title: feat(apple): copy or save rendered widgets as images from the chat transcript

question: After the filename repair and real-device proof, should this Apple counterpart be sponsored for merge alongside the already merged Android widget-export capability?
rationale: This adds a new native user-facing export surface and carries the protected `maintainer` label; the merged Android counterpart supports the direction but does not replace explicit review of the Apple implementation.

options.title: Sponsor after proof and repair
options.body: Accept the cross-platform feature direction once the filename bound is fixed and redacted signed-app evidence demonstrates the native actions.

options.title: Defer Apple export
options.body: Keep the Android behavior only for now and pause this PR if maintainers do not want the Apple surface in the current release.
